title: The Fake Affair
synopsis: A canned mystery used by automated tests. Someone has stolen the last breath of Professor Plumtree, and the fake clues know who.

setting.description: A house built entirely for automated tests.

victim.name: Professor Plumtree
victim.description: A retired inventor with too many enemies.

characters.name: Colonel Mustardseed
characters.title: The Colonel
characters.publicBio: A retired soldier with a loud voice.

private.backstory: YOU ARE THE MURDERER. You swapped the professor's tea for poison to hide your gambling debts.

secrets.text: I owe the professor a fortune.

knows: The gardener was in the greenhouse.
private.alibi: I was in the library reading.

characters.name: Mr. Greenfinger
characters.title: The Gardener
characters.publicBio: Knows every poisonous plant in the garden.

private.backstory: You grow foxglove, which looks bad.

secrets.text: I grow foxglove in the greenhouse.

knows: You saw the colonel near the kitchen at nine.

act1: Plants don't poison people. People do.

secrets.text: I read the will last week.

objectives: Hide that you read the will.
knows: The colonel argued with the professor about money.

act1: Uncle was so kind to me.

characters.name: Mrs. Butterworth
characters.title: The Cook
characters.publicBio: Makes the professor's tea every night.

private.backstory: You made the tea, but someone else carried it up.

secrets.text: I let someone else carry the tea tonight.

objectives: Find out who carried the tea.
knows: The colonel offered to carry the tea.

private.backstory: You know the poison was in the tea.

clues.title: The Teacup
clues.text: The professor's teacup smells bitter, like crushed foxglove.

clues.title: An IOU
clues.text: An IOU signed by Colonel Mustardseed for a large sum, due tomorrow.

clues.title: The Will
clues.text: The will leaves everything to Miss Plumtree.

clues.title: Kitchen Note
clues.text: Mrs. Butterworth's note: 'The colonel insisted on carrying the tea up himself at nine.'

clues.title: Hidden Bottle
clues.text: An empty poison bottle hidden in the library, where the colonel says he was reading.

explanation: The colonel carried the poisoned tea himself.
He owed the professor money he could never repay.

timeline.event: The colonel carries the tea upstairs.

finale.text: The colonel was led away. Case closed.
